POSTHOC_MATCHED128_2V2_DUAL_BRANCH.note: all four cells (A@A, B@A, A@B, B@B) on all 128 seeds of the SPENT block; no seed spent, block status unchanged

READING.per_system: V(A,A), V(B,A), V(A,B), V(B,B); Delta_A = V(A,A) - V(B,A); Delta_B = V(B,B) - V(A,B); the same deltas on score margin (blue - red)
READING.comparison: paired within seed against the old asymmetric Ours rows sealed on this block (standardized_2v2_split_k1_confirmatory_specialist_crossover_eval_rows.csv)
READING.statistics: mean +- std (ddof=1) per delta; 95% paired percentile bootstrap (n=20000, alpha=0.05, rng 7) via eval_hog_psp_v3._mean_ci
READING.behavioral_metrics: none: no behavioral metric is frozen for this evaluator's rows (blue, red, win, margin only)
READING.top50_lesson: keep the top-50 result as provenance: old asymmetric A@A = 1.00 on its own selected top-50, 0.64 on the full 128
